notes.title: Anniversary Update - Update 1.2
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24497382/7cdcc30f5977174c2c28b0bf459394bec39667c1.jpg
Our horror arcade videogame Insane Decay of Mind: The Labyrinth is now one year old and a renewed, involving Anniversary Update has finally been released. As you probably know, the protagonist is Katherine, a mysterious girl who wanders through the corridors of her own mind, desperately seeking for a way out.
However, this will not be a quiet journey-not at all. She will walk in a very eerie environment which will capture you, giving you shivers and disturbing you soul.
The final glitches have been fixed and the Shadows’ AI have been refined. The Shadows’ presence in the bigger maps has been enhanced, too. You will even find them quarreling, from time to time. Creepy, isn't it?
In addition, some new traps have been added: don't take this path lightly, it is trickier than you might think. Also, many random triggered events will make your experience even more lively and enjoyable. You'll see the Monster of the Labyrinth eating corpses and even attacking the Shadows.
You will end up identifying yourself with Katherine and her insanity will affect you deeply. Are you ready to live this nightmarish adventure?
You can find some artworks of some of the new events that you'll face in the Labyrinth below. Check them out!

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Let there be music!

With the 1.1 update, we added a procedural dynamic soundtrack that will enhance the game immersion and the fear-system.

We also fixed several glitches that affected the game, such as the framerate-dependence of physics simulation and animations. 

The new stereo rendering system allows you to have a comfortable experience even at an unstable framerate.

We remind you that with the previous patch we finished porting the game to a new version of the graphic engine and it is able to unleash the true power of your GPU.


Unleash your insanity!

- Francesco

notes.title: Update 1.09
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
We're back on Insane Decay of Mind, providing a new series of updates.
With the 1.09 patch we finished porting the game to a new version of the graphic engine. In fact, the game can now release the true power from your Nvidia GTX 10XX or AMD RX 4XX gpu: maxing the game settings, you're now able to disable the static lightmaps and render dinamic lights and shadows, even in VR Mode (we recommend a GTX 1070 to have a perfect experience at maximum settings with an HTC Vive or an Oculus Rift). In conclusion, we also fixed several glitches ad improved the model of the "Creeping Shadow".
Have fun!

- Francesco

notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.notes:
Thanks to the 1.07 Insane Decay of Mind update, you'll find out that so many new things have been introduced.
First of all, you will feel the story more present than ever: want to be part of a disturbing journey that will cause you shivers throughout your skin? You know what you should be playing at.
Secondly, the labyrinth is even more mysterious, full of secrets that are waiting to be disclosed by you.
Finally, drown into Katherine's mind; discover her past and get fascinated.

- Beatrice

notes.title: Update - Quest System, Envirorments, AI and Bugfixes!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

  Thanks for all the comments and feedback on the Community Hub and for all the feedback in your reviews.

  We've taken on board everything you have been saying and we are still working on the game but we have a big update for you ready now!

Changelog:
Improved Quest System: Draggable quest objects, more intuitive logic
Improved Envirorments: More interactive hallways and jump-scares
Improved Narrative System: Cutscenes and writing on walls lead the player through the Insane Decay of Mind world
Improved Enemy AI
Various improvements and bugfixes

http://i.imgur.com/c2B0l5b.jpg

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.notes:
Hey guys! 
We are still working on some bugs and trying to improve the gameplay in general. Thanks to this new update 1.06, you're going to forget flat and monotonous hallways and replace them with livelier ones! We've also raised the horror level and introduced some jumpscares that will make you focus on the game like never before!
- Francesco

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! After a few days of hard work we managed to correct some major bugs which seriously compromised the gameplay. In this new version, 1.05, we have simplified the way side-quests work and the intuitiveness of the gameplay in general. We want to thank all youtubers and reviewers for their feedback. They are constantly helping us improve our game.

Cheers
Domenico, GoManga Interactive
